title: Federated content checker: add a control mode and reject baselines with empty trees
description: Follow-up from the OMARK-93 Stage 1 review (claude-opus-5-5, APPROVE at 94f05edb), not started. Finding 1, tooling half: "either add a control mode to the checker or reword this AC template. The AC asked for something the tool cannot do." The literal v0.13.0 positive control in the same invocation cannot run because checkMarketplace resolves only the refs in marketplace.json and check-federated-content.mjs:100 rejects any baseline whose ref is not the pin. NIT 5 (pre-existing): "A baseline whose trees is empty or missing passes and counts as verified, with nothing compared. Possible follow-up: require at least one tree per in-scope baseline." (check-federated-content.mjs:104-111). Needs a plan word before starting.
